note: Three campgrounds: Lakeside and Lakeside Extension by the dam on Lake Bronson, and Two Rivers in the woods ~1.5 km east. Lakeside and Lakeside Extension are closed and the lake drawn down while the DNR replaces the dam (from fall 2024, completion expected by July 2027); Two Rivers stays open. The DNR calls Two Rivers' access road and loop roads narrow and 'not meant for large rigs'. --Claude
summary: DNR spk00208 + ReserveMN 125 read: $24/$34 confirmed; 152 drive-in sites (67 electric, Lakeside 20/30/50 A, Two Rivers 30 A), 50-ft limit + six 90-ft pull-throughs; showers/flush/dump seasonal; 2027 season 05-14..10-24 (Two Rivers). Lakeside loops closed for dam replacement until ~July 2027 (note). Split candidate (Lakeside vs Two Rivers). Phone added.
flags: Partial closure (note, not status): DNR alert updated 2026-11-03: 'The Lakeside and Extension Campgrounds remain closed due to construction.' Dam project 'began in fall of 2024 and is expected to complete by July 2027'; 'The Two Rivers Campground will remain open during the construction project.' ReserveMN lists only Two Rivers (facility 842); no Lakeside facility is bookable.

Split candidate: Lakeside + Lakeside Extension (by the dam; ~48.724,-96.623, the stored pin, read from the DNR park map) and Two Rivers (ReserveMN unit centroid 48.72598,-96.60350, 96 sites) are ~1.46 km apart on separate campground roads (DNR map). Two Rivers is the only part open until ~July 2027. If not split, the pin could move to Two Rivers while Lakeside is closed; stored pin is right for Lakeside.

Rig wording: the DNR says of Two Rivers 'The road to the campground, as well as the campground loop roads are narrow. Not meant for large rigs.' and ReserveMN names the facility 'Two Rivers Campground Not accessible to large RV's'; its pads are 30-60 ft. A 23-ft rig is not a large rig; kept with the caveat in the note.

Waterfront (kept not waterfront): Two Rivers units are tagged '.3 mile' from water (94 of 96) and sit in forest well back from the South Branch Two Rivers. Lakeside's shore sites could not be judged: the lake is drawn down and ReserveMN has no Lakeside unit points; worth a look once the lake refills (after ~July 2027).
